content.raw_text:
How to do Page Navigation without memory leak

I have a WPF application with a frame.
<Frame x:Name="MainFrame" NavigationUIVisibility="Hidden" Height="200"/>
When I use the Navigate() method to navigate to a new page the old one seems to stay in memory.
When I use the Navigate() method multiple times the process eats up more and more memory.

I tried to call the Garbage Collection manually which didn't work.
Setting the page to KeepAlive="False" also didn't seem to help.
